description: This file contains Python code for generating C++ classes and enums from JSON schema definitions, including functions for emitting code, handling restrictions, and processing enums and objects.

classes.name: Restrictions
classes.description: A class for managing and evaluating restrictions and conditions on JSON object properties.

methods.name: IsObjectRestricted
methods.description: Checks if a JSON object or property has a 'range' restriction.

methods.name: IsObjectOptionalOrOpaque
methods.description: Determines if a JSON property is optional or opaque based on schema and parent properties.

methods.name: IsObjectOptional
methods.description: Checks if a JSON property is optional, considering nested properties.

methods.name: ProcessEnums
methods.description: Processes enum objects for registration and code emission.

methods.name: EmitEnumRegs
methods.description: Emits C++ enum registration code based on JSON enum definitions.

methods.name: EmitObjects
methods.description: Emits C++ class code for JSON objects, including constructors, operators, and validation methods.
